title: Case Study: Empowering a Dutch Industrial Park with Dawnice 1MW/2MWh Mega-Scale Containerized ESS (May 2026)
summary: A 1MW/2MWh containerised system for a Dutch industrial park, built inside a 20ft enclosure.
challenge: Dutch industrial users face strict carbon footprint standards alongside volatile time-of-use tariffs, so the park needed scale and grid interaction in one package.
solution: A standard 20ft container carrying 1MW/2MWh, with two 500kW Megarevo grid-tied inverters running in parallel for redundancy.
result: The project entered pre-commissioning in May 2026; the IP54 enclosure uses front-to-rear active thermal flow for outdoor siting.
